newsitem.title: FINLAND: APPEALS COURT FOR BIRKA VS STATE - BIRKA.
newsitem.headline: APPEALS COURT FOR BIRKA VS STATE - BIRKA.

text.p: Shipping company Birka Line AB said in a statement on Monday the Helsinki appeals court found in its favour upholding a district court ruling that the state should pay Birka damages of 28.5 million markka plus interest.
Annual interest of 16 percent runs on the amount since Narch 20, 1991, according to the verdict, Birka said.
The state may submit until November 18 a new appeal to the supreme court, it added.

The damages Birka is due to receive from the state partly overlap with a 55 million markka compensation awarded earlier in a settlement between Birka, the bankruptcy estate of Wartsila Marine and Metra Oy Ab , Birka said.
